scripts.dev: bun run dev:api & bun run dev:web
scripts.deploy:web: bun run --cwd workers/web build && bun run --cwd workers/web deploy
scripts.deploy:all: bun run deploy:api && bun run deploy:web
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd workers/api typecheck && bun run --cwd workers/web typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/database typecheck
scripts.cf:typegen: bun run --cwd workers/api cf:typegen && bun run --cwd workers/web cf:typegen
